_doc: Head-phantom geometry for the API source mode — CsI ring at 2 radiation lengths. Bore-700mm variant: crystal r_inner 350 mm (patient aperture ~60 cm after cryostat), 43 phi-blocks (51.1 mm arc) x 7 wheels = 358 mm axial (nominal 35 cm); same block technology and detector constants (r_inner, n_phi, n_z, half_length); wall = 2 X0 of CsI (X0 = 1.860 cm -> 3.720 cm; the CRYSP 3.5 mm FWHM position resolution is measured on 2X0 crystals). The phantom section is a PLACEHOLDER — in mode="api" the driver replaces it with the phantom built from the scenario's phantom_regions.csv. Dimensions in cm; material keys into data/materials.json.
